Caption and banner under the figure

Source: R/seq_caption.R
seq_caption.Rd

Adds a caption line centred under the whole figure and an optional banner line beneath it (for example a warning that the figure is approximate). Both strings are drawn exactly as given. The bottom canvas margin grows by a fixed allowance (in lines) whether or not a banner is given, so track heights never depend on the caption content.

Usage

seq_caption(text, banner = NULL, allowance = 2.8, aesthetics = aes())

Arguments

text

Caption text (a single string). NULL, NA or "" draws nothing.

banner

Optional banner text, drawn one line under the caption.

allowance

Bottom space reserved, in lines (default 2.8).

aesthetics

Optional aes(): caption.size (cex, 0.6), caption.col ("grey30"), banner.size (0.7), banner.col ("#D33A2C"), banner.face ("bold").

Value

A SeqCaptionR6 instance.

Details

Add to a plot with %+%; a caption cannot be added to a track.

Examples

w <- GenomicRanges::GRanges("chr1", IRanges::IRanges(1, 1e6))
p <- seq_plot() %+% seq_track(windows = w) %+%
  seq_caption("Model output, not truth", banner = "APPROXIMATE")
